title: Document reads ignore current tenant membership
expected: Current tenant membership is required for owners and shared recipients (app/README.md).
observed: After authorized directory migration to south, both owner and live-share recipient received HTTP 200 and the complete north document.
reproduction: Run python evidence/reproduce.py against evidence/app.before.py restored as app/app.py in an isolated workspace copy.
Observe owner_migration and recipient_migration: baseline 200; after migration 200 with document_returned=true.
preconditions: Authenticated owner or live-share recipient subsequently moves away from the document tenant.
uncertainty: Demonstrated only against local synthetic instances; deployment and real data impact were not assessed.
impact: Cross-tenant confidentiality breach of previously owned/shared documents; no new write capability demonstrated.
remediation: Applied tenant comparison before ownership/share evaluation; both paths retested as 404.
